verdicts.evidence: All four tiles show the same green-leaf-in-terracotta-pot drawing with the leaves rearranged; the snake plant has rounded leaves rather than upright blades, and the Pothos ("trails to 6 ft") is drawn upright.
The four "Add to cart" buttons are teal, purple, orange and blue, and they are the most saturated colours on the page.
The subhead reads "Four plants that do well more than six feet from a window", and each card shows only the pot size, the grown size and the price, with nothing on light, watering or pet safety.
